subjects.desc: Santa Claus (a jolly old man with a big fluffy white beard and mustache, rosy round cheeks, red Santa hat with a white pompom)

shots.camera: The camera holds a static shot on a tripod.
shots.action: Starting from <Picture 1>, Santa Claus sits in the round hole in the frozen lake with his bare raised wrist showing the plain round watch. He brings the wrist closer to his face, squints at the watch for a moment, then lowers it and looks at the camera. He says his line warmly, smiling under his big white beard, and winks with his right eye on the words good night. After the line his lips close, he gives one slow wave with his raised hand and sinks a little deeper into the icy water.
